specification.question: Do I need a complete technical specification?
specification.answer: No. The project can start with a business problem, workflow or product idea. The Discovery Sprint is designed to turn that into a technical plan.

team.question: Can you work with my existing team?
team.answer: Yes. I can work independently or alongside internal developers, product teams, agencies and infrastructure teams.

onlyAI.question: Do you only build AI products?
onlyAI.answer: No. Useful AI solutions usually require standard product engineering, APIs, databases, authentication, dashboards and integrations around the AI layer.

models.question: What AI models do you use?
models.answer: The model depends on the use case. Architecture can use OpenAI, Anthropic or other providers depending on capability, security, cost and operational requirements.

internalTools.question: Can you build internal company tools?
internalTools.answer: Yes. Internal tools, workflow automation and AI-assisted operational platforms are strong use cases.

afterLaunch.question: What happens after launch?
afterLaunch.answer: Projects can continue through an ongoing product engineering partnership for improvements, new features, security and maintenance.

CybersecurityConsulting.intro: Enterprise network and security engineering for teams that need controlled change, dependable systems and a clear view of risk. Work directly with Alex Nicoară, Cybersecurity Engineer.
CybersecurityConsulting.riskIntro: Start with the environment you have. Understand the paths, controls and operational constraints before deciding what to change.

architecture.title: Network & cloud architecture

assess.body: Understand the environment, business impact and risk.

design.title: Design
design.body: Define the intended controls and a rollback approach.

validate.title: Validate
validate.body: Check assumptions and agree acceptance criteria.

implement.title: Implement
implement.body: Coordinate a controlled change with the responsible team.

verify.title: Verify
verify.body: Confirm behavior and document the resulting state.

CybersecurityConsulting.enterpriseTitle: Availability and security belong in the same plan.
CybersecurityConsulting.enterpriseBody: Production environments need more than a fast configuration change. The engagement should account for business impact, maintenance windows, validation, rollback and documentation. Security and infrastructure teams need a shared understanding of what changes and how success is verified.
CybersecurityConsulting.proofBody: Alex Nicoară’s public background spans enterprise security engineering, network security and cloud infrastructure, alongside building digital platforms for real-world use.
CybersecurityConsulting.fitBody: CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, Security Managers and network security teams who need an independent engineering perspective or additional technical capacity. Particularly relevant when network and cloud complexity makes risk, access or change difficult to reason about.
CybersecurityConsulting.notFit: Not a fit for requests to bypass access controls or obtain a security guarantee without reviewing the environment.

team.question: Can you work with our existing security team?
team.answer: Yes. The work can support your security and infrastructure teams through technical review, design and agreed engineering tasks.

production.question: Do you work on production environments?
production.answer: Production work requires agreed access, scope, validation and rollback responsibilities. The approach is defined with your team before changes are made.

review.question: Can you review an existing architecture?
review.answer: Yes. An initial review can help clarify connectivity, security boundaries and the risks that deserve further investigation.

delivery.question: Is this advisory or implementation?
delivery.answer: The scope can include review and advice or agreed engineering work. We define the deliverables, responsibilities and operating constraints together.

CybersecurityConsulting.finalTitle: Have a security problem that is difficult to untangle?
CybersecurityConsulting.finalBody: Let’s review the environment, the risks and a practical next step.
